I'm an Assistant Teaching Professor in the Applied Mathematics & Statistics department at
Johns Hopkins University.

I care deeply about making university mathematics better taught and more accessible. To that end, I have been busy building [interactive visualizations](projects/visual-math-lab.qmd)
for teaching, [redesigning courses](projects/index.qmd) from the ground up, and occasionally
[formalizing mathematics](projects/lean-formalization.qmd) in the Lean theorem prover.
